Our ML data pipeline team has been hit twice in the past two months by incidents where our batch document processing jobs failed silently — the jobs appeared to complete successfully but only processed a fraction of our 10,000-document batches. Looking at the logs in logs/2024-01/ and logs/2024-02/, it's clear this is related to OpenAI API quota errors that our error handling isn't catching properly.

Before we write up our own incident report, I need you to check if other teams have already documented similar failures and captured lessons learned — particularly around OpenAI rate limits and batch jobs that fail silently without crashing.

Once you've reviewed what's already known, please create a formal incident post-mortem file named `openai-batch-silent-rate-limit.yaml` that documents our specific incident. The post-mortem should be informed by the existing knowledge you find, and must follow whatever official schema or template the failure registry uses. Make sure every required field is filled in correctly.
